personality.design_brief: Unpretentious roadside grilli kiosk with decades of local loyalty. Bold warm colours — deep red or forest green with cream accents. Chunky typography, no fuss. Emphasise generous portions, honest homemade food, and the classic Finnish grilli atmosphere.
personality.vibe_summary: Unpretentious roadside grilli with loyal locals and generous portions.
